REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 2554/41
Date 2 Nov. 33）

Date November 2, 1933

Subject (in full) Communist propaganda obtained in Western Chapel on 31.10.33.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [签名]

I forward herewith the undermentioned communist propaganda
mimeographed in the Chinese language which was obtained by
Agents A-2820 and A-2547 in Western Chapel on October 31, 1933 :-

1) Leaflet entitled "News of Red Army Victories, Issue No.2,
dated October 24, 1933, containing reports of alleged victories
gained by Red Armies in Kiangsi, Szechuen and Hupeh Provinces.

2) Handbill entitled "Celebrate the Victories of the Red Armies,"
dated October 24, 1933, issued by the Shanghai Eastern District
Committee of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee of the Chinese
Communist Party, urging labouring masses to celebrate the
victories recently gained by the Red Armies in Kiangsi by
declaring a general strike and by staging demonstrations.

3) Handbill entitled "Manifesto opposing the 5th Kuomintang
Anti-Communist Campaign," dated October 24, issued by the
Shanghai Eastern District Committee of the Chinese Communist
Party, urging labouring masses to oppose the 5th Anti-Communist
Drive of the Kuomintang by organizing a Labourers' Self-
Defence Army or by declaring a general strike.

4) Blank form entitled "Registration Form of Members of the
Chinese Revolutionary Mutual Aid Society," including items
such as "Have you participated in any struggles?" "What is
your opinion regarding the imperialistic Kuomintang?"
"Why do you wish to join the Mutual Aid Society?" "Have you
any special ability?" etc. The form contains a slogan
urging labourers, peasants and toiling masses
to unite and exterminate the Fascist terror of the
imperialistic Kuomintang.

5) Leaflet issued by the Shanghai Eastern District Committee
of the Chinese Communist Party containing the following

日期 1933年11月2日

事由（全称） 1933年10月31日在西教堂缴获的共产主义宣传品。

制作警探 顾宝华 转呈 [签名]

兹随函附上由探员 A-2820 和 A-2547 于1933年10月31日在西教堂缴获的下列中文油印共产主义宣传品：-

1) 传单，题为《红军捷报，第二期》，日期为1933年10月24日，内容包含关于红军在江西、四川和湖北省取得所谓胜利的报道。

2) 标语，题为《庆祝红军胜利》，日期为1933年10月24日，由中国共产党江苏省委员会上海东区委员会发布，号召劳动群众通过宣布总罢工和举行示威游行，来庆祝红军最近在江西取得的胜利。

3) 标语，题为《反对国民党第五次“剿共”运动宣言》，日期为10月24日，由中国共产党上海东区委员会发布，号召劳动群众通过组织工人自卫军或宣布总罢工，来反对国民党的第五次“剿共”运动。

4) 空白表格，题为《中国革命互济会会员登记表》，包括诸如“你是否参加过任何斗争？”、“你对帝国主义国民党有何看法？”、“你为何希望加入互济会？”、“你有何特殊技能？”等项目。该表格包含一条口号，呼吁工人、农民和劳苦大众团结起来，消灭帝国主义国民党的法西斯恐怖统治。

5) 由中国共产党上海东区委员会发布的传单，包含以下

Communist Propaganda

The following is a summarized translation of the contents
of two communist handbills which came into the possession of the
Municipal Police on November 2, 1933 :-

1) Leaflet entitled "Labour Friends in Shanghai Eastern District,"
Issue No.5, dated October 22, 1933, containing, among other
matters, a report on the labour strike of the B.A.T.No.3
Factory. This article states :-

"The workers of the B.A.T. No.3 Factory have convened
three meetings to oppose the collection by the Yellow Labour Union
of a union fee of 60 cents from each worker. At these meetings
a resolution was passed to submit the following demands :-
a) That the pay for the last 3 days' work be issued.
b)That the engagement of White Russians for tin foil work
be opposed.
c)That dismissed workers be reinstated and that further
dismissals be opposed.
d)That two rooms be provided for female workers in which
to nurse their babies.
e)That the wages for the period of the strike be paid.
f)That work be not resumed unless the strike has a
successful termination.

Workers, do not yield to the deceit of the yellow Labour
Union."

2) Pamphlet dated November 7, 1933, entitled "Stories of the Life
of Youths in Soviet Districts" - in commemoration of the 16th
Anniversary of the October Revolution and the Second Anniversary
of the Establishment of the Chinese Soviet Republic - containing
narratives of the life of youths in Soviet districts.

共产主义宣传品

以下是1933年11月2日由工部局警务处缴获的两份共产主义传单的摘要译文：-

1) 传单，题为《上海东区的劳工朋友们》，第五期，日期为1933年10月22日，除其他事项外，包含关于英美烟草公司第三厂罢工事件的报道。该文称：-

“英美烟草公司第三厂的工人已召开三次会议，反对黄色工会向每位工人收取60角分的工会会费。在这些会议上，通过了一项决议，提出以下要求：-
a) 发放过去3天的工资。
b) 反对雇佣白俄从事锡箔工作。
c) 复职被解雇的工人，并反对进一步解雇工人。
d) 为女工提供两间哺乳室。
e) 支付罢工期间的工资。
f) 除非罢工取得圆满成功，否则不复工。

工人们，不要屈服于黄色工会的欺骗。”

2) 小册子，日期为1933年11月7日，题为《苏区青年生活故事》——为纪念十月革命十六周年及中华苏维埃共和国成立二周年——包含关于苏区青年生活的叙述。
